name: compact-capture-headers
goal: Comparison cards show revision identity without capture labels or duplicate full-size controls; clicking images still opens them.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Remove capture-status captions and duplicate Open full size buttons from the shared comparison header; image activation and revision roles stay available.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing overview tests required Focused capture and activated the redundant text button. Strengthen the normal visual matrix and focused fixture to require revision-only captions, and verify image pointer and keyboard activation in the existing page flow.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: At test-only 5c6ef994 over main 9fb0505e, record 0784ea73 reproduces the extra caption and duplicate full-size controls. All three relationship and canonical route cases pass. It retains 165 screenshots and 398 runtime observations.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Removed capture-status captions and redundant full-size buttons from EntityScreens; kept image pointer and keyboard activation, revision roles and viewer provenance. Synchronized the registered component contract.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Record 8db84cb1 at ca66f810 passes the unchanged 11 render, 10 responsive browser and 3 canonical route cases against main 9fb0505e. It retains 165 screenshots and 398 runtime observations.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
